name: BYOM-incompatible endpoints (rollup)
summary: Endpoints whose model parameter is NOT routed through gateway connections: embeddings, TTS, STT, fine-tuning, batch, realtime (WebSocket).
description: These endpoints take a model name that maps to an Azure OpenAI deployment on the Foundry account itself. There is no documented way to BYOM-route them. Rollup card so each one doesn't need its own status-only entry.
notes: Status-only. If any of these gain BYOM support in the future, split into individual cards.
